question: After the ICE and reconnect defects are fixed, should the bundled Mattermost plugin ship this opt-in direct-message voice-call POC as a supported feature?
rationale: Technical repairs cannot determine whether OpenClaw should support this large experimental capability, native binary dependency set, and new configuration surface in a bundled plugin.

options.title: Ship after transport fixes
options.body: Keep the feature plugin-local and merge after ICE, reconnect, package, and real-call proof are complete.

options.title: Keep it experimental
options.body: Leave the draft unmerged or move the POC outside the bundled plugin until its support and platform scope are defined.

recommendation.title: Ship after transport fixes
recommendation.body: Keep the feature plugin-local and merge after ICE, reconnect, package, and real-call proof are complete.
